044c16bc-3c56-4e27-80b2-c34289d4152e.name: Seaside Meadows
044c16bc-3c56-4e27-80b2-c34289d4152e.description: This region marks the gentle transition from rolling countryside to the vast expanse of the sea. Here, windswept grasses meet sandy shores, creating a tranquil, sun-drenched haven.

dna.looks: Expansive, open vistas dominated by the meeting of land and sea. Rolling dunes covered in hardy grasses give way to wide, sandy beaches and the shimmering ocean. The horizon is often a clear, unbroken line where the blue of the sky meets the blue of the water.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Bathed in bright, natural daylight, with sunlight reflecting off sand and water. The palette shifts to include sandy beiges, ocean blues, and the muted greens of dune grasses.
dna.atmosphere: The air is crisp and carries the distinct tang of salt and brine. Gentle, persistent sea breezes are common, sometimes carrying the cries of seabirds. The atmosphere is open and liberating, a stark contrast to the more sheltered countryside.
dna.materials: Primarily sand, weathered wood from driftwood, smooth stones, and tough, resilient coastal vegetation. Surfaces are often textured by wind and water erosion.
dna.mood: Evokes a sense of vastness, freedom, and a peaceful, natural transition. It inspires feelings of relaxation and open-ended exploration.
dna.sounds: Waves crashing, seabirds calling, wind whistling through dunes, distant foghorns
dna.secondary_surfaces: Weathered wood, smooth stones, resilient grasses
dna.secondary: Ocean blue and muted dune green
dna.palette_bias: Earthy tones, greens, blues, and natural wood hues
dna.flora_base: Hardy coastal grasses and maritime plants

044c16bc-3c56-4e27-80b2-c34289d4152e.searchDesc: Expansive beaches and dunes where countryside meets the sea, with salty air and the sound of waves.

structure.spatialLayout: Characterized by wide, open spaces with a strong sense of depth. The transition from gently sloping dunes to the flat expanse of the beach creates a gradual, sweeping dimension.

0083ae83-6613-4621-a561-a9dd22260e40.name: Seascape Haven
0083ae83-6613-4621-a561-a9dd22260e40.description: A charming beach house nestled on the edge of the Seaside Meadows, offering sweeping views of the ocean. Its weathered exterior blends seamlessly with the natural coastal environment.

dna.colorsAndLighting: The exterior is a tapestry of faded beiges and muted blues from weathered wood and coastal paint. Bright, natural sunlight reflects off its surfaces, creating gentle highlights.
dna.atmosphere: The air here is perpetually fresh, carrying the sharp scent of salt and sea spray. A constant, gentle breeze whispers through the surrounding grasses, hinting at the vast ocean beyond.
dna.materials: Constructed primarily from sun-bleached and sea-worn timber, with accents of smooth, sea-tumbled stones. The textures are rough and organic, reflecting the natural elements.
dna.mood: Evokes a sense of peaceful solitude and effortless connection with nature. It inspires relaxation and quiet contemplation.
dna.sounds: Waves, seabirds, wind, distant foghorns, creaking wood
dna.accent_features: Seashells incorporated into pathways, weathered shutters

dna.palette_bias: Earthy tones, greens, blues, and natural wood hues
